steps.name: Elio
steps.text: Lupina, here is the bill of lading for this order of your winery's grapes by Saluzzo Vino.

steps.name: Elio
steps.text: You can look over the details.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Let me see—

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Everything seems to be in order. You're always on top of things.

steps.name: Elio
steps.text: I'm flattered.

steps.name: Elio
steps.text: Lupina... there is something which I'm not sure I should ask, in my position.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Why the formality?

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Go ahead, Zio Elio. We've known each other for so long.

steps.name: Elio
steps.text: Ever since Kazimierzian wine entered the market—

steps.name: Elio
steps.text: You've been running a surplus of grapes at your winery, which has been good for us...

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Your prices are reasonable, and it helps us clear inventory. It's a deal that benefits both sides.

steps.name: Elio
steps.text: Yes... but the amount that you're offering in this batch...

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Is it too much for you?

steps.name: Elio
steps.text: No, no, we use all the grapes we can get. But are you leaving any for your own wine production?

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: You can tell?

steps.name: Elio
steps.text: Lupina...

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Golden Prairie approached us a little while back.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: They offered to buy the Verdi Winery... and they made an offer I couldn't refuse.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: The winery is going under, despite our best efforts...

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: At least Golden Prairie's interest shows that our equipment and vineyards are worth something.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Thank you for everything, Zio Elio. Saluzzo Vino has always been a good partner to the Verdi Winery.

steps.name: Elio
steps.text: But... what about the other guys? Davide? What about Niccolo? Did he agree?

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: ...I'll convince them.
No, Lupina! How could we sell our Verdi Winery to the Kazimierzians?

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Calm down, Niccolo. Let's sit down and talk about this. There's wine, and there's food.

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: What's that...?

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Our signature wine, Sangiovese. You know it well, don't you?

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: Yes... I remember this label. Old Verdi, your nonno, painted it himself.

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: I was raising the grapes when he first developed this wine!

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: Trimmed them vine by vine myself. The clippers were heavy and unwieldy, especially in winter, when you're out all day in the cold.

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: But it was worth it. These vines are older than all of us put together.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: In Kazimierz, they trim their vines with machines, so they can go through a whole vineyard in a single day.

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: It's not the same. Those stupido machines rip the vines apart. It may save time in the short term, but the grapes don't have long to live once they're done with them.

spans.text: machines rip the vines apart. It may save time in the short term, but the grapes don't have long to live once they're done with them.

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: They don't know how to trim along the grain of the vine, ensuring that the fruits get proper sunlight and develop the right flavor...

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: You kids don't know the old Siracusan craft, and no one wants to learn anymore.

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: The Siracusan wine is unique because every vine is as old as the famiglie.

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: Caring for a grapevine is like caring for family. At least, it was for your nonno.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Niccolo...

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: Think about it, Lupa. Every grape in Verdi Winery is picked from a vine older than your nonno.

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: Workers like us have spent our whole lives picking grapes, carrying barrels, making wine.

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: My son inherited my craft. Even my granddaughter is selling wine for the winery.

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: Where will we go, if the winery is sold?

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: I'll make sure everyone is taken care of. Your skills won't go to waste.

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: I—would the family we've built here still exist, after the winery is sold and all the workers have gone their separate ways?

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: To me, it's better to die with dignity now, than to continue to try to scrape by in Nuova Volsinii. Give it a decent ending, while this land still has value.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Severance will be paid according to our contract terms.

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: It's not the severance I'm worried about!

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: You were never all that interested in running the winery, but don't you feel anything for this place old Verdi kept running all those years?

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Nonno wouldn't want his winery to go bankrupt. It's not such a bad thing to find a new home for it. This is Nuova Volsinii, Niccolo, and it's time we accepted the new order.
The old worker stays silent for a while.
Finally, he takes out an invitation from his pocket and puts it on the table.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: What's that...?

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: My granddaughter Betti turns ten next week. We'll do this by the old rules of Siracusa.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: She's ten already? I'll have to—

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: I'm leaving.
At a small, unremarkable home in a quiet alley.
It is already late when Lupina arrives.
A warm light greets her as she opens the door.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: I knew I'd find you here.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: This is my private bar. You'll always find me here when I'm free.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Here, your usual. One Tramonto with extra orange juice, less syrup, and six cubes of ice.

spans.text: with extra orange juice, less syrup, and six cubes of ice.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: I thought you'd be busier.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: The Kazimierzians' Red Wine Championship is in just a few days. Golden Prairie sent out an invitation to all the local wineries.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: We're not really in a position to participate... but I suppose you'll be there?

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: It's a marketing opportunity, no matter who's organizing it.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Yes, it is an opportunity.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: But I've made the necessary arrangements. I don't need to be there personally, for the rest.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: You prefer to hide here and mix drinks at your leisure?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Just a little hobby of mine. You have your hobbies too, don't you?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Would you care to check the drum set over there for me, my dear vintner?
She sits down in the drummer's chair and starts banging out a lively rhythm.
Her foot stomps steadily on the cymbal pedal, while the movements of the drumsticks in her hands are clean and confident.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: 'Se muoio in guerra, seppellitemi con un fiorino, versa le lacrime di mamma, sulla mia tomba come vino...'

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: A song that every Siracusan child knows. You've brought it to Nuova Volsinii.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: An arrangement. The original is too melancholic for this occasion.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: The streets are filled with vibrant Kazimierzian wine ads. A Siracusan must learn to read the room.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Maybe not all the time.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Elio told you about our winery.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: That's what you're here for.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: What's your plan?

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: The Kazimierzians are coming to audit the assets tomorrow. I've already signed the letter of intent to sell.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: There weren't many workers left by the time papá took over from nonno. There's no point in carrying on.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Traditional winemaking methods are time- and labor-intensive. The winery was operating at a loss by the time papá passed it to me.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: A shame. But since you've already made your decision—what do you need from me?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: It's not like you to hesitate.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: The remaining workers... they're all skilled veterans. They'll do well no matter where they go.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Saluzzo Vino has dozens of wineries under your label. There must be places that could use a pair of skilled hands.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: I'm not trying to force them on you.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: I know the famiglie's rules. You will be doing me a huge favor, one that I'm not in a position to repay.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Just give them a chance, check them out and assign them based on your assessment and needs...

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Nothing to be nervous about.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: It's only natural that you'd want to take care of your family. And I do need to hire more hands.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: ...Grazie.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: All's well with the workers, but what about you?

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Me? I guess I'll... chase my dreams in music?

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Frankly, I think I'm a much better drummer than I am a vintner.
The feigned nonchalance is accompanied by a series of drum riffs.
They echo in this little private bar, never leaving the room.

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: I... can't... I can't just...

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: Who's there? Elio... you're still here?

steps.name: Elio
steps.text: Let me help.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: It's so quiet... I can hear the ringing in my ears.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: This used to be a lively place... the sounds of footsteps, barrels rolling, metal and glass clanging against each other, bubbles sizzling while grapes ferment...

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: And now, it's all...
There is only silence left.
Lupina slowly walks past the warehouse, the cellar, the vat.
She knows this may be the last time she makes these checks.
Her hand touches the antiquated equipment, the marks of age—
The handle of the presser falls off the screw.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: No... the Kazimierzian auditor is coming soon! How could my equipment break at a time like this?!

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Oh, this stubborn old stuff... got to screw it back—

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Ought to be just like a lightbulb—

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: It's stuck?
Lupina...

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Davide? Good timing! Come, help me fix this thing.

steps.name: Davide
steps.text: The vertical screw is completely stripped. It won't go back on.

steps.name: Davide
steps.text: I was just going to tell you, I was doing my regular checks when I found a problem with the filtration system's hydraulic cylinder.

steps.name: Davide
steps.text: It's cracked and can't maintain hydraulic pressure.

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: Lupa, the Kazimierzians are here.

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: A fine classic villa, Signorina Verdi. The wolf's head on the wine barrels is quite detailed, and even the stone tiles in the cellar are tastefully ornamented.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: It was my grandfather who painted them.

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: Shall we discuss what to do with your family's artwork? Would you like us to remove it intact and return it to you, or include it in the purchase?

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Remove it?

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: Since the paintings on the tiles are the work of your late grandfather, we can arrange for an art preservation expert to remove them for you, should you wish. I assure you, they will not be damaged.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Oh, then yes, please.

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: The expert's fee will be at your own expense, of course.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: I knew it... fine, I'll pay. Please make sure the tiles are removed intact and undamaged.

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: Shall we proceed to the next item?

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: Crusher, fermentation tank, presser, thermostat, filtration system... you have a full complement of winemaking equipment.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Yes, it was my grandfather who procured it. They were the most popular models at the time... very durable.

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: Your grandfather? That was a while ago, then.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Still, it works well. Please, come and see our crusher.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: This machine crushes grapes with minimal loss. My grandfather retrofitted it with extra-wide rollers, increasing production by—

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: There seems to be an issue with the sealing ring on the machine's connector, if I'm not mistaken?

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: Equipment assessment is not my specialty, but I am under the impression that the sealing ring should not be exposed.

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: And your thermostat... I took note of the temperature reading when I passed it. The temperature seems suboptimal for winemaking.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Well... yes, the equipment may be a little old.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: But our workers maintain it regularly, and we have all the necessary spare parts on hand. We can get it repaired quickly.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: It will not affect delivery.

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: Ah, if that is what you're concerned about, there is no need to worry.

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: Your equipment was not included in our initial assessment.

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: Traditional Siracusan equipment is inefficient and incompatible with our production lines. We did not intend to keep it to begin with. You may dispose of it as you see fit.

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: This includes the oaken casks in the warehouse that you showed me—

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: These handmade casks create uncontrolled impurities in the storage process, which are detrimental to quality control for mass-produced wine.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: You don't use oaken casks?

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: We have replaced traditional oaken casks with steel containers, which have better hermetic properties and are more responsive to temperature control.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: It'll lose a lot of flavor—

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Merda, I sound like my nonno.

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: That will be a question for our inspector to worry about. I suggest you focus on whether the offer meets your expectations.

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: I assure you that you have nothing to worry about.

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: It is the land on which your winery sits that we are interested in. We will offer a fair price for it.

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: We get a plot of excellent land, while you receive a reasonable payment in turn. It's a win-win arrangement.

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: I will document the results of the audit, then our legal representative will contact you to finalize the contract.

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: Please reach out to her if you have any questions.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Would you like to try a sip?

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: If I recall correctly, we bought out Verdi Winery's inventory last month, as you were in urgent need of liquidity to make payroll.

steps.name: Auditor
steps.text: There will be no need to see me out. Have a nice day, Signorina Verdi.
The Kazimierzian leaves the winery with his briefcase, takes one glance at the lonely vineyard, then gets into a black car that has been waiting for him outside.
It takes a long while, until the sound of the car's engine is long gone, for Lupina to come to her senses.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: It's over. Nonno's winery sold, just like that...

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: I thought... they would care more about our traditions and equipment...

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Niccolo.

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: The presser and crusher, the thermostat and filtration system—

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: I was the one who broke them.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: I know. I'm not here to blame anyone.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: You've been here so many years. I doubt you thought breaking a few piece of equipment would stop the purchase.

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: I just...

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Hoped that they would stay?

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: The pipes... Elio...

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: He did something else?

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: I wanted to stop him, but...

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: I understand your anger... what's done is done. if the auditor didn't find it, there's no reason for us to tell them.

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: Lupa...

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: I wasn't much of a businesswoman, but I know how to tell a good guy from a bad one.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: That drunk papá of mine wasn't even born when you started working at the winery with my nonno.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: You know, he used to measure my height with this presser. See the lines on the cylinder?

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: It's for the best that it broke. At least it couldn't be sold.

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: Verdi Winery was my entire life. I watched every new bottle go out the door, saw us weather one storm after another.

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: I thought my granddaughter, or maybe my grandddaughter's granddaughter, would get to see the new bottles going out... I didn't think it would end this way.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: If continuing the old ways won't protect them, maybe this is for the best.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: ...Is there anything else I can do?

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: My son would like you to come to his daughter's tenth birthday party.

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: With a bottle of wine her age, as is tradition.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Niccolo
steps.text: And take good care of this winery, until it really changes hands, mio caro Lupa.

spans.text: And take good care of this winery, until it really changes hands,

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: 'My dear vintner, I would very much appreciate if you would pay a visit to my private bar. You may help yourself to my collection.'

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: He told me to come, but he's nowhere to be found.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: People in Siracusa die every day. How's that enough to shut him up at home?

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: And he wants his guests to mix their own drinks...?

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: It's been a long time since I've done it... what was it that nonno said?

a.text: Winemaking is a slow and gradual process. The wine begins to gain its unique flavor during fermentation, like a family slowly brought together.
Sometimes, wines and juices of different flavors are mixed together before being presented for tasting.
No, you're too young to drink.
That's a paintbrush, not a drumstick... I'm not done painting yet—
Yes, you can play with it once I'm done. Look, this is our vineyard. This big wolf head is me, and the small one is you.
You want to paint a couple of brushes too?
Two drumsticks? My, my, mio caro Lupa sure has her own ideas.
You want to be a musician, the most rhythmic drummer on Terra? Then nonno's gonna be the best painter on Terra! Haha!
No, I'm not angry. See? I'm painting right now, on a wine bottle—
I'll take you to the cellar when it gets warmer and decorate the walls. I've wanted to do this for a long time. It took years just for the idea to take shape.
I want you to both inherit the winery, and have the freedom to become a musician.
Your family should not make you give up your dreams.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Guess it's come to this, nonno.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: I couldn't even come up with a bottle from this year.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: Maybe a bit of music to lift the mood?
The drummer walks to the instrument.
There is a finely wrapped gift box on the stool on which she has often sat. She lays down her drumsticks, opens the ribbon-wrapped gift box, and finds a bottle of wine within.
The label features two wolf's heads by the grapevines, one large, one small, with two drumsticks by the ears of the smaller wolf drawn with childish lines.
The label says, 'Verdi 1092'.
The drummer lays her hand on the bottle gently, then puts it back inside the box and takes up the drumsticks. The sound of song begins to echo through the bar.

steps.name: Lupina
steps.text: 'Se muoio in guerra, seppellitemi con un fiorino, versa le lacrime di mamma, sulla mia tomba come vino...'
